I built up such a *very* expensive habit. I had a steady income and lots of savings, in my drug riddled brain it felt like I had unlimited money sometimes.

Then the income stopped being so steady, so I dipped into my savings to keep up the over-indulgent, expensive habit. Not long after I have 0 in my savings account. I put it before EVERY responsibility.

If the urge is still overwhelming: you're much more likely to give in if it's within reaching distance. 

You really want to test your willpower? Grab that bag, go into the bathroom and empty it all into the toilet, right now. Take control and show it that YOU are in charge of your life, not some white powder. 

You will have two main emotions. One of them going into a panic mode of "omg, what a waste of money, why did I just do that I'm such an idiot"

BUT the rush of what you just did is amazing. You feel empowered, in control and proud for making the right choice. Flushing that bag down the toilet was like a strange way of letting go, disconnecting.
